title: Over-Encumbrance Counts as One Size Larger

sections.what: Carrying >= 50% of maximum carrying capacity adds an effective size tier to the character, restricting traversal through narrow gaps.
sections.why: Carrying too much should make a character count as one size larger for passage, but there is no connection between carried weight and size gating.
sections.how:
- Items already have a `weight` property.
- When total carried weight exceeds a threshold, the character counts as one size larger for movement and size gating (crawl / climb / jump).
- Slot into existing movement gating, which is being built in task-187 character-size-passage-movement.

acceptance.text: Effective size tier increments when carried weight reaches encumbrance threshold.
Narrow passages enforcing max_size block over-encumbered characters.

files: engine/movement.py - apply encumbrance-driven size bump in crawl/climb/jump gating
engine/item_actions.py - expose total carried weight for the encumbrance threshold
